title: A finite locally free quotient admits a local section
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $0\to\mathcal E_1\xrightarrow{u}\mathcal E_2\xrightarrow{q}\mathcal E_3\to0$ be a short exact sequence of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, with $\mathcal E_3$ locally free of constant finite rank in the sense of [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module]. For every point $x\in X$ there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $x$ and an $\mathcal O_U$-linear map $s:\mathcal E_3|_U\to\mathcal E_2|_U$ such that $q|_U\circ s=\mathrm{id}_{\mathcal E_3|_U}$.
